cultural_notes: Denver, the Mile High City, sits where the high plains meet the Front Range of the Rocky Mountains; the LoDo district preserves red-brick warehouse architecture around Union Station (source: diningout.com Denver farmers markets; region knowledge -- verify architectural framing before production)

Colorado farmers-market season runs May through October -- from spring asparagus to the pumpkin harvest -- with Paonia cherries and Palisade peaches as the marquee summer-fall fruit (source: denverpost.com Denver/Boulder farmers markets 2025)
metro markets are anchored by Western Slope growers -- Palizzi Farm (Brighton) and Forte Fruits (Palisade) among them (source: diningout.com 2026 Denver metro farmers market guide)

Denver has a deep-rooted Chicano/Hispano community shaping the food culture, and is the staging metro for the I-70 ski corridor (Loveland, Winter Park, Copper, Breckenridge, Vail) (INFERRED cultural + geographic framing -- verify tone before production)
